title: ‘Come forward’: police say people ‘know the whereabouts’ of alleged Porepunkah killer Dezi Freeman
summary: Members of the public are helping harbour the gunman alleged to have shot dead two officers, police believe Victoria police believe people are helping harbour alleged Porepunkah gunman Dezi Freeman, saying some members of the community know where the fugitive is. Speaking to media on Monday afternoon, Supt Brett Kahan said Freeman’s network was “wide” and asked those who know where he is to come forward. Continue reading...

title: Oil Weakens as Putin and Modi Huddle in China After US Tariff
summary: Oil declined following a monthly drop in August, with traders focused on concerns over a potential glut and signals over Russian supply.
